title: Hoover letter calling Condon a Russian spy

tellings.quote: I believe it was, um, Jed Ghuber wrote a letter, um, to Congress.

plain: Robert Salas, a former US Air Force officer, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a letter from 1949 in Washington, D.C. He says he believes J. Edgar Hoover, the head of the FBI, wrote to Congress calling a scientist named Edward Condon a Russian spy. Salas raises it because it would cast doubt on Condon's standing, a man whose name comes up in the history of how the government handled UFOs.
